shared_elements: figures scattered across a flat field
justification: Both surfaces show schematic figural imagery — A a crowded field of dancing/running human silhouettes with dotted infill, B a pillar bearing quadrupeds in profile, a bird, snakes and a row of repeated arched motifs above a banded zone; the only real correspondence is the generic presence of animate figures and a horizontal register of repeated elements. The subject matter differs fundamentally: A is a dense human dance/action scene with no clear registers or animals in profile, while B is dominated by isolated animals arranged in ordered registers with no human crowd.
